resources.string: "The file includes settings, the background image, saved regions, places, routes and courses. It may contain precise coordinates and timestamps. Select its location with the system file picker. Import is validated and processed locally; the app does not upload the file."
"Finish and save the current route before importing or exporting configuration"
"The operation was interrupted. Select the file again."
"Cannot export configuration. Check the data, available storage and target file permissions."
"Cannot import: invalid format, version or contents, or a file larger than 40 MB. Existing data has not been changed."

"The file contains %1$d saved regions, %2$d places, %3$d routes, %4$d courses and %5$d random selection lists. Import replaces existing settings and included data. Random selection data is retained if absent from an older file."
"\n\nThe background image will also be restored from the file."
"\n\nThis older file has no background image. The current background will be kept."

"\n\nContinuous background location and camera access will be turned off. Review the Wolfx notice on this device before enabling that source again. Permissions, recent location, caches and request limits are not restored from the file. Continue?"
"Import failed. The previous configuration was restored."
"Import failed and some previous settings could not be restored. Check available storage and import a valid file again."
"Region catalog: GeoNames, Wikidata and other sources ↗\nSee the notes for coverage and coordinate sources"

"The Chinese city catalog combines administrative lists with GeoNames. Where no suitable point is available, it uses Wikidata CC0 coordinates. The Caohu government seat uses OpenStreetMap data, © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Each coordinate represents a point within the city, not the entire administrative area. Online district and overseas searches use Open-Meteo geocoding. See the link below for sources, verification dates and licensing."
"1.2.10 · Configuration restore and city catalog audit"

"• Added full configuration import, validation and overwrite confirmation. Export now includes the background image. Permissions, caches, recent location and request limits are not transferred.
• Added developer rules for each update and release.
• Current version labels now read package metadata.
• Rebuilt the city catalog: 4 mainland municipalities, 293 prefecture-level cities, 398 county-level cities, 23 Taiwan cities, Hong Kong and Macao, plus Suzhou districts and the industrial park. Former cities are search aliases for current districts; autonomous prefectures, prefectures and leagues are excluded as city entries.
• Stable administrative and source identifiers unify local, saved and online results. Per-entry sources document coordinate checks.
• Based on Chinese release 1.2.10 / versionCode 34."
"Enter # followed by six hexadecimal digits, for example #246BCE"

"Restore default global and tab settings, location method, course prefixes, semester and class times. Saved courses, places, routes, random selection lists, favorite regions and weather cache are retained. If existing courses require more weeks or periods than the defaults, the required range and corresponding class times are kept."
"Only objects above the horizon are drawn; the daytime chart is a direction reference. Tap the center of an object for details. A rotating broken cross marks the selection."

"Sky pointing works only in horizontal coordinates and with the coordinate grid hidden. The chart remains fixed; a solid red cross marks the device direction on the sky and is hidden below the horizon. It uses the rear camera direction by default; the top edge can be selected in astronomy settings. Direction is calculated from the rotation-vector sensor and corrected to true north using estimated magnetic declination for the selected region. Select your actual observing region. Magnetic interference, sensor accuracy and device axes affect the result. This is an observing aid, not a navigation tool."
"Camera brightness sampling is unavailable. Check camera permission and availability."
"Auto-exposure unlocked; the system may compensate brightness"

"Dual-profile measurement requires manual exposure support. If it is unavailable or rejected, the app attempts to lock automatic exposure and reports the fallback state.\n\nImage processing, lens differences, dark noise and highlight clipping affect readings. Camera brightness is not illuminance and cannot replace a calibrated lux meter."

"• One color selector controls text and buttons, with seven presets and hexadecimal colors. Dark buttons always use white text, with pale companion backgrounds.
• Course colors support seven presets and custom values, with safe migration of older colors.
• Restore defaults, bottom tabs and cache management are now in global settings.
• Sky pointing moves a small red cross over a fixed chart using the device orientation, only in horizontal and no-grid modes. Explanations appear below the chart.
• Search results and saved regions show longitude and latitude.
• Camera sampling fixes exposure and sensitivity where supported, otherwise attempts to lock auto-exposure and reports the actual status.
• Based on Chinese release 1.2.11 / versionCode 35."
"This is the minimum interval requested from the system for network location updates. The system may delay updates or reuse existing results."

"This setting applies to current weather timestamps, hourly forecasts, astronomy, earthquakes and route point details. By default, weather and astronomy use the selected region time zone, while earthquakes and route details use the device time zone. Daily forecasts and sunrise/sunset keep the selected region calendar. The timetable uses the device date to determine the current week."

"• Configure action buttons, links, body text, headings, selection text and explanatory text separately. Default colors are blue, black, black, black, black and gray. Dark buttons retain white text.
• Status settings are grouped by location, satellites, sensors and battery. The network location interval explanation now appears above its options.
• Preset course colors use names; custom colors use hexadecimal values. Existing course colors are retained.
• Added internal padding to course editor fields.
• Based on Chinese release 1.2.12 / versionCode 36."
"Enter ISO 1–204800 and exposure time 1–1000 ms. Actual values depend on device capabilities. Saving applies this profile without changing the other profile."
"1.2.13 · Historical text resources and camera parameters"

"• Migrated historical UI text and version history to XML resources while preserving parser fields and saved identities.
• Camera sampling defaults to ISO 1000 and 200 ms, with adjustable requests clamped to device capabilities and automatic-exposure-lock fallback.
• Removed the top-edge label above the Places diagram.
• Version 1.2.13 / versionCode 37."

"The UV Index indicates the potential harm of ultraviolet radiation to skin and eyes. It has no unit. The value shown here is the weather model's estimate of today's maximum for the selected location, not a current measurement. Thin cloud does not necessarily remove the need for protection.

Low (below 3): Short outdoor activities present a lower risk for most people. Take precautions if you have sensitive skin, spend a long time outdoors, or are near strongly reflective surfaces such as snow or water.

Moderate (3 to below 6): Seek shade, wear a sun hat, UV-protective sunglasses and clothing that covers the skin, and apply broad-spectrum sunscreen to exposed areas.

High (6 to below 8): Use stronger protection. Avoid the hours of strongest sunlight where possible and reduce prolonged exposure. Combine shade, clothing and sunscreen rather than relying on sunscreen alone.

Very high (8 to below 11): Unprotected skin can burn more readily. Limit time outdoors during the strongest sunlight and use comprehensive protection.

Extreme (11 and above): The risk of sunburn is very high. Avoid outdoor activities during the strongest sunlight where possible. If you must go out, seek shade and use full protection.

Choose broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher that protects against both UVA and UVB, and apply the amount specified on the product. During continued outdoor activity, usually reapply every 2 hours and after swimming, sweating or toweling. For babies and young children, prioritize shade and protective clothing. Skin type, altitude and reflected sunlight affect individual risk. Sun protection cannot block all UV radiation."
"UV Index and protection reference · US Environmental Protection Agency"
"Sun safety reference · US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention"
"All sections are shown by default. Use the checkboxes to choose visible items and the arrows to reorder them."
"All sections are shown by default. Use the checkboxes to choose visible items and the arrows to reorder them. Data attribution remains visible."

"Weather, Timetable, Status, Earthquakes and Random selection are shown by default. Keep at least one tab visible. The bottom bar is hidden when only one tab is visible; with five or more visible tabs, use the arrows to browse them."
"The default order is the order of addition. Use Move up and Move down to reorder items; editing does not change their position."

"• Sky alignment now starts and stops the chart sensors in place, preserving the reading position.
• Expanded UV Index categories and protection advice, with official reference links.
• Open in browser now uses a link with no background.
• Switches, checkboxes and radio indicators remain blue; choice text colors remain customizable.
• Removed the default-off label from the China Earthquake Networks Center option while retaining its activation confirmation.
• Settings explanations appear below the controls, with default sequences documented on ordering pages.
• Version 1.2.14 / versionCode 38."

"Indoor and outdoor readings alternate between two exposure profiles. They are image-brightness references, not illuminance. Each reading shows the actual exposure time and ISO, subject to device limits."
"The device could not apply both manual exposure profiles. Only an automatic-exposure reference is shown below."
"Default sensitivity: ISO %1$d. Default exposure time: %2$d ms."
"System battery optimization is currently enabled for this app."
"System battery optimization is currently disabled for this app."
"No supported battery-optimization settings page is available on this device."

"Find this app in the system battery-optimization list and choose the option to stop optimizing it, which may reduce power restrictions on ongoing location updates. Names and paths vary by device. Exemption may increase power use; it does not enable continuous location or background camera access, nor guarantee uninterrupted background operation."
"1.2.15 · Clearer text and camera light sampling"

"• Removed redundant defaults, instructions and data notes while retaining ordering rules, licensing and measurement limits.
• Global settings add Permissions and system restrictions, grouping app permissions, system location and battery optimization.
• Camera ambient-light sampling can be paused and resumed below its readings; pausing closes the camera.
• Indoor and outdoor brightness samples appear together. Indoor defaults: 200 ms and ISO 1000; outdoor defaults: 5 ms and ISO 50. Both profiles are configurable.
• Samples are matched to their actual exposure results. Unsupported manual exposure is reported with an automatic-exposure fallback.
• Configuration import and export include both profiles; older camera settings remain the indoor profile.
• Separate system current and charge units support nonstandard readings, with raw values for verification. Android standard units remain the default.
• Version 1.2.15 / versionCode 39."
"This device does not provide an available system settings page"

"Android specifies microamperes and microampere-hours; the app converts these to milliamperes and milliampere-hours. Some devices may use different units. Verify each source unit separately before changing it; brand or magnitude alone is insufficient. These settings only change conversion, not hardware calibration. Changing units cannot recover a reliable value if the system does not supply one."
"Clear the current results and previously drawn items to use all candidates again. Saved lists are retained."

"Enter one item per line, or separate items with commas or semicolons. Blank items are ignored and identical items are merged. Each item can appear only once per draw. Changing the candidates resets draw progress on the next draw."
"Use up to 2,000 candidates, with no more than 200 characters per item and no control characters."
"Enter a whole number greater than 0 and no greater than the available count (%1$d). Reset draw progress if too few items remain."
"Delete “%1$s”? Current candidates and draw results are retained."
"Use a unique, nonempty name of up to 80 characters. You can save up to 100 lists. If the combined list content is too large, delete lists you no longer need."

"Previously drawn items are included by default, and animation is enabled. When exclusion is enabled, draws use only items not yet selected from the current list. Reduce the draw size or reset progress if too few remain. Loading a list resets progress. Animation only presents the draw and does not affect its results; disabling system animations shows results immediately. Lists, drafts and results stay on this device and are included in full configuration export and import."
"Random selection data could not be read. Try importing a previously exported full configuration."

"Adds a Random selection tab for entering candidates, choosing a draw size, and saving or loading lists. Supports excluding previously drawn items, resetting progress and copying results.\n\nIncludes an optional cycling text animation that slows to a stop. Non-repeating samples use the system secure random source. Drafts, results, lists and progress are stored locally and included in full configuration transfer, with support for older configuration files."

"When enabled, the app asks the system to keep the screen awake while it is in the foreground. Leaving the app or disabling this option restores the system sleep policy. It does not keep the app running in the background."

"Adds a Keep screen awake setting. When the app has been fully exited and opened again, camera-based ambient-light sampling starts paused and must be resumed from Status.\n\nFixes simultaneous draws so the animation cycles the same number of items as the final result. The tab is now named Random draw. Saved-list actions use spaced buttons without revealing an intermediate list dialog; the rename field has a pale background from the moment it opens. More spacing separates Show results now, Copy results and Reset draw progress. Adds a remaining-items view and places Save list beside Saved lists."
"This shows candidates that have not been drawn from the current pool. Editing the candidates rebuilds draw progress on the next draw."
"1.3.2 · Draw animation and battery optimization wording"

"Fixes clipped bottom items during multi-item draw animations. The animation reserves space for the draw count and wrapped candidate text, with Show results now below the items.\n\nBattery optimization status now uses enabled and disabled wording."
Changes the app interface language only. User-entered content, saved data and external websites retain their original text. Unsupported system languages fall back to Chinese.

Adds English throughout the interface. Choose Simplified Chinese, English or the system default under Global settings → Language. Switching takes effect immediately and preserves the current section and saved data. Language preferences are included in configuration import and export. Major versions mark changes to underlying code or usability.
